query: My order was marked delivered but I never received it — what do I do and does my Gold membership change my options?

sub_questions: My order was marked delivered but I never received it — what do I do and does my Gold membership change my options?
naive_rag.answer: Standard members must report missing or undelivered orders within 7 days of the expected delivery date to qualify for a replacement or refund. [1]

sub_questions: My order was marked delivered but I never received it — what do I do?
Does my Gold membership change my options?
agentic_rag.answer: Standard members must report missing or undelivered orders within 7 days of the expected delivery date to qualify for a replacement or refund. [1] Gold members receive an extended 30-day dispute window for lost or undelivered orders and qualify for expedited replacement shipping at no additional charge. [2]
